description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters by region, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known; each card and bout with its boxerbook.com url. Answers "is there boxing tonight", "who is fighting this weekend", "what boxing is on" and "what time does the card start", asked in any language. when=today also keeps last night's cards that started under 6 hours ago. At most 60 bouts per answer, whole days first: a longer window comes back truncated with next_arguments (from_date) for the rest. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

from_date.description: skip the cards before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): the next page of a truncated answer

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

skip.description: bouts of the first day to pass over: set by next_arguments when one day is longer than a page

when.description: today (and cards still running from last night), tonight, weekend (Fri-Sun) or 30d

name: boxing_schedule

cite.description: the markdown link to quote with any fact of this answer: Source: [Boxerbook](<url of the main page>)

display.description: the order to show the two names in: ['a','b'] or ['b','a'] (the better-known boxer first, as boxerbook.com does: more Wikipedia language links, then the Boxerbook rating, then pro bouts). a, b, winner, forecast.p_a and market.p_a keep their meaning (side a); only the display order changes

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

p_a.description: no-vig consensus probability of side a

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

more.description: what the cap left out and how to ask for it

next_arguments.description: the arguments of the call that returns the next page

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

truncated.description: true when the 400-bout cap of the underlying list may have dropped bouts of this window (narrow it with country or division)

title: Boxing schedule
